build_dart_dataset: build the DART dataset builder to download and extract structured RDF triples with text annotations
create_dart_info: create the DART dataset info with features describing input table triples and target text descriptions
test_dart_split_generators: test the DART _split_generators method to return train, validation, and test split generators
refactor_dart_generate_examples: refactor the DART _generate_examples method to yield input table and target text pairs from JSON data
review_dart_class: review the DART class extending tfds.core.GeneratorBasedBuilder for structured data record to text generation
